description: Header file defining the NinjaBinaryTargetWriter class, which generates build rules for binary targets (executables, shared libraries, static libraries) in a build system, including dependency classification and build line writing.

classes.name: NinjaBinaryTargetWriter
classes.description: Class responsible for writing ninja build files for binary targets, handling dependencies, build rules, and linking.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the process of writing the ninja build rules for the target.

methods.name: GetClassifiedDeps
methods.description: Retrieves and classifies dependencies of the target.

methods.name: ClassifyDependency
methods.description: Classifies a dependency as linkable or non-linkable and updates the classified deps structure.

methods.name: WriteCompilerBuildLine
methods.description: Writes a build line for compiling sources with specified tool and dependencies.

methods.name: WriteLinkerFlags
methods.description: Writes linker flags to the output stream.

methods.name: WritePool
methods.description: Writes pool information for build rules.

methods.name: AddSourceSetFiles
methods.description: Adds source set files to object files list.
